ReportsPage and ReportRunner keep loading/error/empty/partial/success mutually exclusive: a rejected run leaves result null and renders report-error; a successful zero-row response alone renders report-empty; partial responses render report-partial and never hide the reason.

ExportService now re-authorizes download: owner, reporting.export, reporting.report.read, current reporting bindings/auth_version scope fingerprint, requested field profile, private file identity, expiry and download count. EXPORT_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED/EXPORT_FIELD_HIDDEN remain 422 validation denials; field-profile revocation or scope/auth-version revocation on download returns 403. No export row is fabricated; money is always rendered in yuan through formatMoney.
